DML.SELECT: SELECT node_parent_id as "nodeParentId", node_child_id as "nodeChildId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.cctv_scenario_node_hierarchies WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.cctv_scenario_node_hierarchies (node_parent_id, node_child_id, enabled, visible) VALUES (:nodeParentId , :nodeChildId , :enabled , :visible)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.cctv_scenario_node_hierarchies SET node_child_id = :nodeChildId, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible WHERE node_parent_id = :nodeParentId
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.cctv_scenario_node_hierarchies WHERE node_parent_id = :nodeParentId AND node_child_id = :nodeChildId
